summary: Curate rows carry pub_date and citations_per_year, and --sort per-year ranks by average citations per year since publication, computed in SQL before LIMIT. Age is years since pub_date, or July 1 of the year when the date is unknown, at least 0.25. The live path rejects per-year instead of sorting by something else.
reason: Callers ranked by citations per year client-side after fetching a citations-sorted and a date-sorted page, because the output had no publication date and no such sort. Ranking in the store over all matches is exact and needs one query. The name velocity is left free for a recent-window measure, since a lifetime average favours old classics.
validated_outcome: go test ./internal/lancet/ and ./internal/cli/ assert ranking before LIMIT, the July 1 fallback, the 0.25 floor, the new JSON fields on every sort, the live-path error and that velocity is rejected.
